name: Dreadmist Den
summary: In the northern Barrens, Burning Blade cultists keep their rites beneath Dreadmist Peak. Red haze fills the cavern they use as a shrine to demons.

sections.title: A Den of Wicked Shadows
sections.body: Dreadmist Den cuts into the jagged slopes of Dreadmist Peak, where Burning Blade cultists gather in a dark sanctuary. Thick crimson vapor hangs through its stone tunnels, dimming the cavern in red twilight. Away from the Horde's watch in the plains below, the cult performs demonic rites, guards its blasphemous relics, and plots to spread corruption across Kalimdor.

sections.title: The Demon Seed
sections.body: Deep in Dreadmist Den, the Demon Seed rests above the Altar of Fire. The cult prizes the artifact for its fel power, and it is connected to the Burning Legion. Ak'Zeloth prepares a power stone to disrupt that connection. Horde scouts and aspiring warlocks who follow the Burning Blade's activity face danger in the cavern as they seek to learn how far demonic influence reaches in the Barrens.

faq.answer: Dreadmist Den cuts beneath Dreadmist Peak in the northern Barrens. Burning Blade cultists use its caves as an enclave and a place for their rites.

faq.q: What causes the red mist inside the den?
faq.answer: Red haze shrouds Dreadmist Den and the peak above it. Burning Blade cultists perform demonic rites there, but the haze's exact cause is unknown.

faq.q: What is the Demon Seed found inside?
faq.answer: The Demon Seed is a dark artifact kept deep within Dreadmist Den. The Burning Blade cult prizes it as a powerful focus for fel magic.

faq.q: Why does the Horde care about this cave?
faq.answer: The Horde fears the Burning Blade's demon worship and its efforts to undermine the Horde across Kalimdor. A stronghold near Crossroads and Orgrimmar threatens the security of the Barrens.

angles.text: As a warlock, you may be drawn to the demonic relics and volatile fel energies within Dreadmist Den, and to the Burning Blade's dark secrets.

As a member of the Horde, you face danger from the Burning Blade den overlooking the Barrens. Its presence threatens nearby trade routes and settlements, calling for swift action from Horde defenders.
